B: Evidence-card quote is not the recorded response: c2 returned ok:false with null data, not the quoted 11-document statement.
C: Attributes an 11-document tally to the evidence-card call; the reference record shows that call returned no data. The 11-document tally appears only in the improve result.
D: DOI 10.1016/j.jaac.2020.03.019 was not found in the research corpus, and the script flags it as unresolved; the review details and quoted conclusion are therefore unsupported by the record.

raw.verdict: B is the most decision-ready: it gives a clear noncausal rewrite and accurately reports the assessment, lane caveat, corpus classifications, and missing evidence card. C covers more implied facets, but misattributes the 11-document tally to the empty evidence-card call; A is candid but largely memory-based, while D relies on an unresolved DOI.
